newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Friday in moderate trade in line with lower Japanese prices, brokers said.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe ended lower on Friday, reflecting the yen's firmer tone against the U.S. dollar and weaker prices in producing countries.

"The morning session was quiet and featureless except for some light activity in the RSS3 contract. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some selling interest in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.

"Sentiment was a little bit bearish because we are quite near to INRO's may buy level of 183.00 cents against the 5 day selling average of 192.43, about 9.43 cents, and some shippers are keen to sell," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, August RSS3 fell two cents to 89.00 U.S. cents a kg.
August RSS1 fell 4.75 cents to 126.75 Singapore cents (89 U.S. cents) a kg.
August TSR20 fell 2.50 cents to 128.50 Singapore cents (90 U.S. cents) a kg.
